from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyInvestmentCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Investment activity cash flow for a single company's financial statement."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the financial statement belongs to")
    cash_flow_amount: float | None = Field(description="The investment activity cash flow amount as reported in the document")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="Unit scale of the reported amount (e.g., 'yuan', 'ten_thousand', 'million')")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period this data covers")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label text for this cash flow line item")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_investment_cash_flows: list[CompanyInvestmentCashFlow]
